verdict.rationale: Restate documents a Testcontainers-based local testing setup that spins up an isolated Restate Server in Docker so developers can exercise handlers without touching a production deployment, and its single-binary/deploy-anywhere design makes standing up an isolated non-prod instance straightforward. However, there is no explicit 'sandbox mode' feature, staging/production data-isolation guarantee, or hosted sandbox environment described. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment feature, documented data-isolation guarantees between test and prod, and independent user reports of using it this way.
